title: Deep Learning Model to Detect Diabetic Retinopathy in 45° Images Using Ground Truth from Ultra-Widefield Imaging.
summary: Deep learning is trained to detect diabetic-retinopathy lesions in masked 45° images using labels from ultra-widefield imaging, with comparison across three image/label conditions in 2,610 participants and 5,180 retinal images.
ai_technology: Multiple image conditions and reference labels test lesion detection; regional population and cross-sectional data bound generalization.
organization: University of New South Wales, Sydney
